title: Divergence: README anchors to RATIONALE.md broken — GitHub slugs ' / '/' + ' headings to double hyphens (4 anchors dead)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: README uses #the-ladder-l3-l2-l1-l0, #the-cage-seccomp-sandbox, #translation-validation-the-lean-proof-spine, #typed-holes-n-the-goal-repl. GitHub's slugger strips '/' and '+' but keeps BOTH surrounding spaces, each becoming a hyphen: actual slugs are the-ladder-l3--l2--l1--l0, the-cage--seccomp-sandbox, translation-validation--the-lean-proof-spine, typed-holes-n--the-goal-repl (double hyphens). All 4 anchors dead on GitHub; commit message claims 'Every anchor resolves'. Demonstrated by slug-algorithm replay over both files (7 of 11 anchors OK, these 4 MISS). Fix: rename headings to avoid ' / '/' + ' or correct the anchors.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Batch doc-only fix of the five pinned findings #218-#222 in RATIONALE.md + README.md (single commit, ref #217). #218: correct 4 README anchors to GitHub double-hyphen slugs (verified by a scripted slugifier over the actual headings, 11/11 resolve). #219: rewrite cage Limits — seccomp-BPF DOES filter scalar args[0..5], the true limit is no pointer dereference (TOCTOU); Direction made consistent. #220: drop old(_) (no such construct; ens ranges over result + params), fix Per/postconditions typo. #221: spine trust base to 5 items matching audit.sh check [6], Lean kernel + 3 axioms as item 1. #222: restore the survey's per-claim novelty hedge across preamble + all three extension notes. Cause-level: corrected the docs to match the authorities (GitHub slugger, seccomp man-page mechanics, spec grammar, audit.sh, SOTA survey).
